intent: Reconcile authoritative human intent with observed repository reality, resolve or explicitly waive every material gap, apply an approved convergence plan, and establish a current baseline before project compilation.
steps: Collect the minimum human material for the requested scope: objectives, users, business rules, constraints, exclusions, prior decisions, and acceptance criteria
Inventory observed code, architecture, tests, data, dependencies, documentation, infrastructure, and technical debt without treating them as product authority
Compare every material observed surface with referenced human intent
Classify each surface as conformant, requiring adaptation, obsolete or out of scope, conflicting, or undetermined
Build an explicit convergence plan using keep, migrate, rewrite, isolate, delete, or clarify actions
Stop for human decisions on ambiguity and obtain explicit human approval before any migrate, rewrite, isolate, or delete action
Apply only approved convergence actions within the declared scope and preserve evidence of their result
Run relevant verification and leave every failed or unrun required check blocking
Produce a machine-readable reconciliation report with no unresolved decision or convergence item
Fingerprint the reconciled project-owned content and mark the baseline ready
invariants: Repository content is observed reality and never substitutes for authoritative human intent
No destructive or behavior-changing convergence action proceeds without an explicit human approval reference
Missing or contradictory human material blocks the affected scope
A ready baseline contains no unresolved decision, unapplied convergence item, or failed required verification
Project compilation remains a separate subsequent operation
